rationale: Re-review after addressing code review comment. CR-001 (session_id set to experiment_name) resolved: both assistant_evaluation_service.py and workflow_evaluation_service.py now generate a per-item UUID as conversation_id, wrap execution in langfuse.propagate_attributes(session_id=conversation_id, ...) so the SDK-owned trace is tagged with the same session, and pass that UUID to CodeMie (as conversation_id / session_id respectively). This ensures the SDK trace and CodeMie's own trace share one per-item session — matching the behavior of the old item.run() runner — and that each item gets its own session rather than all items collapsing into the experiment name. Tests updated to assert a valid UUID is used (not the experiment name) and that propagate_attributes receives the same id that is sent to CodeMie.

finding_status.notes: session_id was incorrectly set to experiment_name, grouping all items into one session and not linking to CodeMie's traces. Fixed: per-item UUID generated as conversation_id; passed to CodeMie and to langfuse.propagate_attributes(session_id=...) so both SDK and CodeMie traces share one per-item session. Applied to both AssistantEvaluationService and WorkflowEvaluationService.

business_review.criterion: Session button in Trace → Metadata shows CodeMie's trace for each dataset run item
business_review.notes: SDK trace and CodeMie trace now share the same per-item session_id (the conversation_id UUID), so the Session button links both traces as the old item.run() runner did.

business_review.criterion: Each dataset item gets its own session (not grouped by run)
business_review.notes: UUID is generated fresh per item inside item_task / run_dataset_item, not derived from experiment_name. Grouping by run is already covered by the dataset run view.

business_review.criterion: Works when SDK environment and CodeMie environment differ
business_review.notes: Session linking is purely by shared session_id value; no environment coupling. The UUID generated in the evaluation task is the same value passed to CodeMie regardless of which Langfuse project each side writes to.

standards_review.notes: propagate_attributes is a purely additive context manager; wrapping the CodeMie call does not change control flow or request semantics.

test_conversation_id_is_unique_uuid_per_item and test_propagate_attributes_receives_same_id_as_conversation_id added for AssistantEvaluationService; test_item_task_passes_unique_uuid_as_session_id updated for WorkflowEvaluationService to assert UUID validity, non-equality to experiment_name, and propagate_attributes / create_executor alignment.
